round11_lanes.brief: art-drop/BRIEF-11.md, including owner continuity feedback and the operator exact path-layout requirement
round11_lanes.calibration: Good enough to ship beside approved art. The three unchanged r11L-4 passes stay passed; no concrete new defect was found in them. Wasteland changed and was regraded.
checks_performed: Compared the complete 192x1104 alpha array of each lane against its own family-path_joined.png. Zero opaque-mask, nonzero-mask and alpha-value differences across every cell in the 4x23 layout. Every piece stays at exactly the required position, width and geometry. All alpha is binary; no partial-alpha halo.
Compared all opaque RGB colours against the corresponding family-road_joined.png palette: zero outside colours in every sheet. Viewed full path/lane/road triptychs at native size.
Viewed every candidate sheet at native size and every source pixel at nearest-neighbour 8x in six non-overlapping bands per file, covering rows 00..22. Saved the same bands at 1x and 4x as well.

Built and viewed cross, T, bend and SW/NE diagonal scenes for all four families on both grass-base and wasteland-wasteland-base at 1x and 4x. Each includes a strip of its own main road and a direct lane-to-road junction. All pieces are unrotated source crops at integer coordinates.

Built and viewed seeded compatible random 8x2 lane networks for every family on both grounds at 1x and 4x. Seed 111 and the actual tile indices are saved in critic-r11L-5-random-layout.json. Shared cardinal connections agree.

Viewed eight-piece horizontal lane/road repeat comparisons for every family on both grounds at 1x and 4x. Also viewed Wasteland long horizontal, vertical and diagonal repeated runs at 1x/4x, plus a direct repeated path/lane/road material comparison at 1x/4x/8x.

Compared the approved markers, all round-2 city/industry/slums summer and winter tiles, all four seasons of paddies, and grass/plains base samples and all eight details in each season at 1x and 4x. These are style controls, outside the verdict scope.
Saved 3x3 controls of both approved ground bases, viewed at 1x and inspected their central wrap junctions at 4x. No candidate terrain bases were introduced into the review scope.

Checked continuity, seam rhythm, brightness steps, per-piece borders/bevels, texture repeat, pixel sharpness, noise, muddy shapes, palette compatibility, light consistency, outline/fringe pixels and material clarity. Mandatory repeated path geometry and necessary join variants were not treated as near-duplicate art defects.
Scifi avoids the stamped cyberpunk grid on its lane; its main-road reference itself has panel lines. Jazz Age uses the actual warm family-road palette and retains its unchanged prior pass.
Rehashed every out/ PNG at the end: no changes during this review. This workflow wrote only to art-drop/review/.
round11_lanes.not_applicable: BRIEF-11 requests only four summer lane atlases used all year. It requests no candidate bases, peaks, one-cell terrain variants, trees, craters, ruins, autumn crowns or winter variants. Candidate-base 3x3 tiling, peak lattice/range, forest compositions, egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, flat orange autumn, identical crowns and blank winter therefore do not apply. Compatible random 8x2 lane networks and approved-base 3x3 controls were nevertheless generated. Approved art was used as a baseline and was not regraded.

jazz_age-lane.reason: Identical SHA-256 to the r11L-4 passing sheet. Warm muted surface, pale kerb and darker inner edge match the actual family road reference. Required network tests remain continuous at 1x/4x; full-sheet 8x inspection found no new defect. Preserve the prior pass; the warm palette is present in the named reference itself.

modern-lane.reason: Identical SHA-256 to the r11L-4 passing sheet. Grey asphalt and thin light kerb match the family network. Required composites at 1x/4x and every source pixel at 8x remain crisp, with no new seam, fringe or material defect.

scifi-lane.reason: Identical SHA-256 to the r11L-4 passing sheet. Quiet dark blue-grey surface, sparse cyan glints and crisp dark edges. No stamped panel grid on the lane; clean network joins at 1x/4x and no new defect in full-sheet 8x inspection.

wasteland-lane.resolved: The previous paired-slash/fork damage cadence has been removed. Exact layout, binary alpha, family palette, clean physical joins and edge sand pass.
wasteland-lane.remaining: Crack contrast and structure have been reduced until damaged asphalt no longer reads at native size; see actionable fail entry.

fail.name: wasteland-lane
fail.problems: FAIL material readability: the revised sheet has removed the conspicuous crack stamps, but has also lost the required cracked-asphalt appearance. At 1x, the horizontal, vertical and diagonal runs on both grass and wasteland read as smooth grey-brown paving with faint specks. Beside wasteland-road_joined, the fractured main road becomes a visibly different material. At 8x the lane has mostly isolated flecks and nearly straight, low-contrast dashes rather than readable angular fissures. Concrete example: zero-based tile 10, sheet x=96..143/y=96..143, has a short horizontal midtone dash at local x=24..30/y=22 over an otherwise largely unbroken centre; this disappears as damage at native size. The long diagonal pieces show the same loss of fracture structure. Restore a restrained amount of thin, irregular, broken angular cracking using the existing road palette: a few connected, mostly lengthwise fissures with short offset branches and occasional darker core pixels, quiet enough to survive repeating the same 48px piece. Do not restore the old paired transverse slashes or repeated forks, and do not turn each piece into a bordered slab. Retain the current edge sand, exact path alpha mask, width, piece positions and clean joins. Recheck eight-piece horizontal, vertical and diagonal runs at 1x on both grounds, next to the main road. Evidence: critic-r11L-5-wasteland-path-lane-road-material-{1,4,8}x.png (path/lane/road, top to bottom), critic-r11L-5-wasteland-*-repeated-runs-{1,4}x.png, and critic-r11L-5-wasteland-sheet-rows-*-8x.png.
